notes: Finalized. Two reported candidates: (1) drivers/infiniband/hw/mlx4/sysfs.c store_admin_alias_guid — uninitialized u64 sysadmin_ag_val passed as sscanf out-param; sscanf return ignored; on non-numeric user write the stack garbage is persisted twice (per-port record store and mlx4_set_admin_guid) and drives alias-GUID work scheduling; sysfs entry read-back is root-only (ADMIN), hence garbage-state variant, not unprivileged disclosure. (2) drivers/scsi/scsi_transport_iscsi.c iscsi_if_set_param — sscanf(data,'%d',&value) return ignored; value initialized to 0 so not a stack leak, but non-numeric CAP_SYS_ADMIN netlink input silently coerces session->recovery_tmo to 0 (immediate session replacement semantics) — adjacent error-path-commit semantics. All other triaged candidates safe (nla_parse zeroes tb in lib/nlattr.c __nla_validate_parse; kstrto* wrappers check returns; copy_from_sockptr in do_sock_getsockopt is best-effort by design and never used as validated input; CAN netlink bittiming paths memcpy fully-validated policy-length attrs and check subsequent errors; pcie-designware-debugfs, hisi_sas, greybus, iwlwifi mld, libie fwlog, ixgbe debugfs, tlclk all check parse results or are root-only debug with checked parses).
